name: Co-working spaces

problems.words: Enquiries from our website and Instagram sit unanswered for a day
quick_ideas: Reply today to every waiting enquiry with a tour offer, so warm leads aren't lost
Name who owns enquiries on each shift, so replies don't depend on who's at the desk.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry inbox from website, social and WhatsApp with tour booking and follow-up reminders.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how full are you right now?
problems.free_stops: the follow-up timing and assignment are set out in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Follow up once with everyone who toured this month, so undecided people hear from you
Ask those who didn't sign one question about why, so you get real reasons.

workzap_build.text: tour outcomes and reasons recorded for every prospect, with follow-ups scheduled automatically.

problems.free_stops: the follow-up sequence is kept for the solution document.

quick_ideas: Move all bookings into one shared calendar, so there's one source of truth
Check next week's bookings once for clashes, so you fix them early.

workzap_build.text: meeting room booking via web or WhatsApp, with clashes blocked automatically.

problems.free_stops: booking rules per membership type are set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Members use meeting rooms beyond their credits and we never charge
quick_ideas: Compare last month's room use against credits once, so overuse shows
Tell members once what their credits include, so expectations are clear.

workzap_build.text: credits tracked per member with overage added to invoices automatically.

problems.free_stops: how credits and overage are calculated is kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Monthly invoices are made by hand and members pay late
quick_ideas: List every member's balance once, so you know who owes what
Send each overdue member a statement this week, so payment is requested.

workzap_build.text: recurring invoices with payment links and late-payment reminders sent automatically.

problems.free_stops: the billing cycle and reminder timings are worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Deposits and refunds when members leave are always messy
quick_ideas: Write one move-out checklist, so every departure is handled the same way
List current members on notice once, so their move-outs are planned.

workzap_build.text: a move-out flow covering access card deactivation, deposit settlement and mail redirect.

problems.free_stops: the checklist steps and approvals are designed in the solution document.

quick_ideas: Ask recent leavers one question about why, so you get real reasons
Check in once with members nearing their third month, so issues surface early.

workzap_build.text: a membership register with start and renewal dates, feedback pulses and exit reasons recorded.

problems.free_stops: the feedback timing is set out in the solution document.

problems.words: Wi-Fi and AC complaints take days to fix
quick_ideas: List every open complaint with the date reported, so the backlog is visible
Name one person responsible for closing each, so nothing drifts.

workzap_build.text: maintenance tickets from members via WhatsApp, tracked until fixed with response times recorded.

problems.free_stops: the ticket flow and response targets are kept for the solution document.

problems.words: Ex-members still have working access cards
quick_ideas: Compare active cards against current members once, so stray cards show
Switch off any that don't match, so the gap is closed now.

workzap_build.text: access card deactivation built into the move-out flow, with a monthly cross-check of cards against members.

problems.free_stops: how the check links to your access system is worked out in the solution document.

problems.words: Two locations run on different spreadsheets
quick_ideas: Agree the same few figures for both sites, so you can compare them
Fill them in once for last month, so you see which is weaker.

workzap_build.text: a location screen with occupancy, revenue, costs, collections and complaints per site.

problems.free_stops: which figures to track and how they're pulled together is set out in the solution document.

never_say: Any lease, real estate, legal, tax or building-safety advice.
Anything involving fake tenancy contracts or addresses for visas or licences.
That occupancy will rise by any amount.
Requests for members' names, IDs, company documents, access codes or Wi-Fi passwords.
Fire, electrical, gas or medical emergencies: point to emergency services first.

sample_reply.person: Our occupancy has been stuck for months. Enquiries come in but replies are slow. What would you do?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, there's a clear place to start, this week. 1) Reply today to every waiting enquiry with a tour offer, so warm leads aren't lost. 2) Follow up once with everyone who toured this month, and ask those who didn't sign one question about why. Workzap can do this automatically for you: one enquiry inbox with tour booking, follow-up reminders and reasons recorded for every prospect. Would you like me to put together a solution document and quote for you? You're free to say no.
